CertificationSQF Food Safety Code for Manufacturing, Edition 9 — Certificate SQF-114772. Kosher certified (Dairy, cRc). Manufactured under a HACCP plan and a Preventive Controls food safety plan per 21 CFR 117. Current certificates are issued as their own documents and are not part of this specification.

This specification describes the medium cheddar cheese powder supplied by Northfield Creamery Ingredients under item NCI-2280. It is intended for use as a flavour and colour ingredient in dry seasoning blends, snack topical applications, sauce and soup bases, and extruded snack coatings. It is not intended for retail sale as a finished consumer product without further processing. All values stated in the specification tables below are acceptance limits for the product; results measured on an individual production lot are reported separately on the certificate of analysis issued with each shipment.

Ingredient Statement

The following statement is the declaration for this ingredient and must be carried through to the finished-product label in descending order of predominance:

INGREDIENTS: WHEY, CHEDDAR CHEESE (PASTEURIZED MILK, CHEESE CULTURES, SALT, ENZYMES), BUTTERMILK, SALT, DISODIUM PHOSPHATE, LACTIC ACID, ANNATTO (COLOR).  CONTAINS: MILK.

No artificial flavours, no added MSG, no hydrolysed vegetable protein, no preservatives. All ingredients are GRAS or are used in accordance with 21 CFR, and no ingredient is bioengineered as defined by 7 CFR Part 66.

Soy lecithin is handled in Room 4 of the Northfield facility on dedicated equipment that shares no air handling, dust collection or product contact surface with the NCI-2280 line. Allergen changeover is validated by ATP swab and by protein-specific lateral flow at a 5 ppm limit of detection. Gluten: this product is not made from a gluten-containing grain and tests < 20 ppm gluten by R5 ELISA.

Shelf Life & Storage

Shelf life12 months from date of manufacture in unopened original packaging
Storage conditionsStore below 75°F (24°C) at 65% relative humidity or less, in a dry, odour-free warehouse, off the floor and out of direct sunlight
After openingReseal the liner and use within 30 days
Date codingJulian code YYDDD followed by the line number, ink-jetted on the bag gusset
TransportDry van, food-grade, previous-load restricted; refrigeration not required

Country of Origin

Country of Origin: United States of America. The milk, whey and buttermilk used in this product are sourced exclusively from Grade A dairy farms in Wisconsin and Minnesota. Blending, pasteurisation, spray drying and packing are all performed at our Northfield, Wisconsin facility (Plant Code 55-0421). No component of this product is imported. Country of origin does not change from lot to lot; any change to this statement will be issued as a new revision of this specification.
